punchline: A weekly yoga class helped women whom years of talk and medication had not reached.
thirty_sec: Van der Kolk's team gave sixty-four women with stubborn PTSD either trauma-sensitive yoga or a health education class, one hour a week for ten weeks. By the end, about half of the yoga group no longer met the criteria for PTSD, against about one in five in the other group. He reads it as evidence that body-based work can do what talking alone sometimes cannot.
